group.title: Group stage
group.format: Single round-robin in one group. Each match is {sets} doubles sets to {setTarget}, no 2-point lead needed.
group.ranks: Low-rank set: ranks {lowMin}–{lowMax} · High-rank set: ranks {highMin}–{highMax}.
group.sets: Each player plays {minSets}–{maxSets} sets and never two in a row.
group.compensation: Roster compensation: a team with fewer players present than its opponent and only one rank-{maxRank} player has that player play at least 2 sets.
group.points: The team that wins more sets wins the match and gets 1 point in the standings.

handicap.title: Handicap
handicap.group: The pair with the lower total skill points starts with the difference, up to {groupCap} per set.
handicap.relay: Knock-out: the signed differences of the {legs} legs are added up, capped at {koCap}, and given at the start of leg 1.
handicap.points: Scoreboard points (handicap included) count toward point difference.

ranking.title: Ranking
ranking.order: Points → head-to-head (2 teams) or mini-table (3+ teams) → set difference → point difference → draw.

knockout.title: Knock-out
knockout.seeds: The top {knockoutTeams} teams reach the semi-finals: #1 v #4 and #2 v #3, then the third-place match and the final.
knockout.relay: Relay of {legs} legs to {finalMilestone}, with milestones at {milestones}.
knockout.minPresent: A team with fewer than {minPresent} players present is disqualified.
